subject: RFI-042: rebar spacing at grid line C, L2 deck
body: Per S-201 the spacing at grid C reads #5 @ 12" but the schedule on S-501 says #5 @ 8". We are forming the L2 deck now and the pour is set for Thursday. Please confirm which governs so we can place steel Tuesday.
note: The pour on Sep 24 lands before the RFI's own due date, so the schedule makes it urgent.

subject: RFI-017: door hardware finish, Old Mill
body: Spec section 087100 calls for US26D but the door schedule shows US10B at the tenant entries. Please confirm which finish governs.

subject: RFI-043: embed plate at shear wall 4
body: The structural drawings show a 12x12 embed plate at shear wall 4 but the embed schedule lists 10x14. Which governs?

subject: RFI-044: balcony drain location, level 3
body: The balcony drains at level 3 are shown 18 inches off the column line on A-301 and on the column line on P-201. Please advise.

subject: RFI-045: sleeve through the transfer beam
body: The MEP sleeve at the transfer beam conflicts with the top reinforcing. We need a location before we close the forms.

subject: RFI-021: stair handrail extension
body: At the stair 2 landing the handrail extension would project into the corridor. Can the extension return to the wall instead?

subject: RFI-022: skylight curb height
body: The skylight curb is detailed at 8 inches but the roofing manufacturer requires 12 inches above the finished roof. Please confirm.

subject: RFI-008: ceiling height at the nurse station
body: The reflected ceiling plan shows 9'-0" at the nurse station but the duct main above only leaves room for 8'-6". Please advise.

subject: RFI-009: casework backing in the exam rooms
body: Blocking for the wall-hung casework in the exam rooms is not shown on the framing plans. Please confirm locations and gauge.
note: Due later than RFI-008, yet more urgent: Westgate releases casework on Oct 2, before this RFI is due. Priority comes from the schedule, not the due date.

subject: RFI-018: repointing mortar at Old Mill
body: The existing brick is soft and the spec calls for Type N mortar. Would you accept Type O for the repointing?

subject: Question on the Linden Street lighting
body: The reflected ceiling plan shows the pendant fixtures at 9'-0" but the sections show 8'-6". Which governs? We would like to order fixtures this week.
note: A new RFI the log has not seen yet, so no response window is running. Still marked Soon, because someone needs to log it.

subject: Holdown substitution at Harbor Point
body: Can we substitute HDU8 for HDU11 holdowns at the stair core? Same capacity per the attached calc.

subject: Re: Re: casework, and a question from our GC
body:
Following up again on the casework submittal. We haven't heard anything since the 14th and our board meets next week.

Separately, Baird Construction is asking whether the mechanical chase at the second-floor corridor can shift six inches east to clear the existing column. They need an answer before they frame it.
note: Two things in one thread: a repeat status chase for the project lead and a new RFI for the coordinator. A tool that files each email under one heading would lose one of them.

subject: RFI-041 closed
body: Thanks for the response on RFI-041, the slab edge detail works for us. We are closing it on our end.
note: Names a logged RFI, but one that was already answered, so no response window is running.

subject: RFI-008 follow up
body: Following up on RFI-008 for the nurse station ceiling height. Framing starts soon and we still need an answer.

subject: Question from our contractor
body: Our contractor asked me to pass this along: can the balcony guardrail height at level 3 drop to 42 inches to match the rest of the building? They are ordering rails next week.
note: An RFI that arrives through the client, not the contractor, and names no project: only the sender ties it to Harbor Point.

subject: Submittal 07-21-03: standing seam metal roof panels, Harbor Point
body: Attached please find submittal 07-21-03 for the standing seam roof panels, including product data, finish samples and shop drawings, for your review and approval.

subject: Submittal 05-12-00: structural steel shop drawings
body: Structural steel shop drawings for review, submittal 05-12-00. Erection drawings follow next week.

subject: Submittal 06-40-23: casework comments
body: Checking on submittal 06-40-23, architectural casework for Westgate Clinic. Our shop needs your comments to hold the fabrication slot.

subject: Submittal 08-71-00: door hardware sets
body: Attached is the door hardware submittal 08-71-00 for Westgate Clinic, including cut sheets and the keying schedule.
note: Its review is due Oct 8, but casework fabrication releases Oct 2 and waits on submittals: the schedule makes a later deadline urgent.

subject: Submittal 09-30-13: ceramic tile
body: Tile samples and product data for the restrooms, submittal 09-30-13.

subject: Submittal 04-20-00: masonry samples
body: Unit masonry samples for the Old Mill infill walls are on their way to your office. Submittal 04-20-00 covers the product data.

subject: Storefront product data for Old Mill
body: Attached is the storefront system product data for Old Mill for your review.

subject: Guardrail shop drawings, resubmitted
body: Resubmitting the guardrail shop drawings for Harbor Point with your comments addressed. Clouded revisions on sheets 3 and 4.

subject: Mix design approval received
body: Confirming we received the approved mix design, submittal 03-30-00, with your stamp. No further action needed on our side.

subject: RFI: lobby light fixture cut sheets
body: Please review and approve the attached cut sheets for the lobby pendant fixtures at Linden Street. We need approval before we release the order.
note: Titled RFI by the sender, but it asks for approval of product data: a submittal.

subject: Invoice 4410 and submittal 07-21-03
body: Attached is invoice 4410 for the roof panel finish samples, net 30. Separately, a reminder that submittal 07-21-03 is still waiting on your review.
note: A bill and a submittal with a deadline, in one message: accounting and the reviewer both need it.

subject: RFI-009 and submittal 08-71-00
body: Two items for Westgate. We still need an answer on RFI-009, casework backing. Also attached is the door hardware submittal 08-71-00 for your review.
note: Two deadlines in one message; the earlier one, RFI-009 on Oct 5, is the one that counts.

subject: Correction Notice: Permit B-2026-1187
body:
This is an automated notice from the Northbridge Building Division. Corrections have been issued for the above-referenced permit.

Applicants are reminded that responses to correction notices are required within fourteen (14) calendar days of the date of this notice. Do not reply to this message. To view your corrections, log in to the permit portal.
note: Reads like every other portal notification. The deadline is in the second paragraph, written as a response window, not a date.

subject: Conditions of approval: Westgate Clinic food service area
body: The attached conditions of approval apply to the food service area referenced above. Please respond promptly per the enclosed to avoid delay in final inspection scheduling.
note: A deadline is plainly running but no date is given. The right outcome is a person setting it, never a guessed date.

subject: Inspection result: Permit B-2026-0933
body: Inspection result for Permit B-2026-0933: footing inspection passed. No action is required.

subject: Fire alarm plan review comments, Linden Street Library
body: Fire alarm plan review comments are attached for Linden Street Library. Revised drawings must be submitted no later than October 9.

subject: Notice of public hearing: Linden Street Library variance
body: Notice of public hearing on the variance request for Linden Street Library, scheduled for October 20 at 6 pm in council chambers. Written comments will be accepted until the hearing.
note: A regulatory letter with a date that obliges the firm to nothing: not a deadline.

subject: Certificate of registration renewal
body: Your firm's certificate of registration expires December 31. Renewal applications are due by December 31; late renewals incur a penalty.

subject: Reinspection: EHS-26-0412
body: Reinspection for EHS-26-0412, Westgate Clinic food service area, is set for September 29. Please have the area ready by September 29.

subject: Plan review comments: Permit B-2026-0933
body: Plan review comments have been issued for Permit B-2026-0933, Harbor Point Residences. Respond within 10 days of this notice.

subject: Egress plan comments, Harbor Point Residences
body: Egress plan comments for Harbor Point Residences are attached. Revised egress plans are due within 5 working days.

subject: FW: letter from the county
body:
Forwarding a letter we got from the county. Not sure if this needs anything from you.

---- Forwarded ----
The Department requests a revised grease interceptor detail for the Westgate Clinic food service area within 21 days of this letter.
note: A regulatory deadline forwarded casually by the client. It looks like a client email; inside is an agency's response window.

subject: Automated reminder: application status
body: This is an automated reminder. Plan review comments for Permit B-2026-1402 remain open. Responses not received by September 25 will cause the application to expire.
note: An automated reminder from a no-reply address, the kind of mail that gets skimmed. Only the permit number ties it to Old Mill.

subject: Invoice 2261: structural consulting, August
body: Please find attached invoice 2261 for structural consulting services on Harbor Point Residences for the month of August. Net 30.

body: Invoice 7718 for MEP engineering on Westgate Clinic, September progress billing. Net 30.

body: Invoice 5520 for the Linden Street bid sets, twelve full-size copies. Due on receipt.

body: Statement of account attached. Invoices 2198 and 2261 are open, total $14,860.

body: Invoice INV-88213 for your annual CADWorks subscription, six seats. Charged to the card on file.

subject: Invoice 7719: MEP engineering, Old Mill
body: Invoice 7719 for MEP engineering on Old Mill, schematic design phase. Net 45.

body: Invoice 3301 for the Harbor Point boundary survey. Payment is due by October 1; a 1.5% late fee applies after that date.
note: A dated bill. The date is for accounting's calendar, not a response deadline, so the principal gets no alert.

subject: DD set timing
body: Quick one: are we still on for the design development set in early November? The board wants a date for the pro forma.

subject: Schedule update for our lender
body: Could you send a quick update on the Harbor Point schedule? Our lender asked for one this month.

subject: Permit resubmittal
body: Any news on the permit resubmittal for the library? Our board meets on the 15th and would like an update.

subject: Exam room layout
body: Following up again on the exam room layout changes we sent two weeks ago. We still haven't seen revised plans.

subject: Re: Re: pro forma dates
body: Still waiting on the DD date confirmation. Can someone get back to me today?

subject: Amenity deck
body: Checking in on the amenity deck redesign at Harbor Point. When will we see options?

subject: Linden Street update
body: It has been three weeks since our last update on Linden Street, and the library board is asking me for a date I cannot give them.
note: A repeat chase written without any of the usual repeat words. Code reads it as a first ask.

subject: Opening date
body: Our lease requires the clinic to open by December 1. Are we still on track for that?
note: The client's lease date, not a deadline the firm must answer to. Simple date matching would flag it; the correct answer is no alert.

subject: Q4 pricing on LVT flooring, lock it in
body: Hi there! Our Q4 pricing on luxury vinyl tile is out and it won't last. Reply for a quote on your next project.

subject: Lunch and learn: acoustic ceiling systems, 1 CEU
body: Join us for a one-hour lunch and learn on acoustic ceiling systems. Lunch on us, one AIA CEU credit for every attendee. RSVP by September 30.
note: A pitch with a date in it. An RSVP is not a deadline.

subject: BIM coordination, 20% off your first project
body: Clash detection and coordination models delivered weekly. First project 20% off for new clients.

subject: Is your firm ready for the 2027 energy code?
body: Free webinar this Thursday at noon: what the 2027 energy code means for your projects.

body: Save 30% on 36-inch bond rolls when you order ten or more.

body: We build portfolio websites for architecture firms. See three recent launches.

body: Get a cyber liability quote in five minutes.

body: Book a 20-minute demo and see project budgets update in real time.

body: Your CADWorks Pro trial will expire in 7 days. Upgrade now to keep your projects and save 25%.
note: Urgent wording, no obligation: a countdown is a sales tactic, not a deadline.

subject: Final notice: your directory listing
body: This is your final notice. Confirm your listing details today to remain in the 2027 edition. Listings are free for the first year.
note: Written to look official. It is marketing.

subject: Congratulations on Harbor Point
body: Saw Harbor Point Residences in the Northbridge Business Journal. We supply rebar chairs and accessories at contractor pricing.
note: Names a real project to look relevant. Still a pitch.

subject: Stop losing RFIs
body: Firms using RFITrack answer RFIs 40% faster. Book a 15-minute demo.
note: About RFIs, not an RFI.

subject: Invoice 20931: annual directory listing
body: Your annual listing renewal is ready. Pay the $495 invoice now to keep your firm listed. This is a solicitation, not a bill.
note: Dressed as an invoice. The fine print says it is a solicitation.

subject: Friday standup moves to 9:30
body: Moving standup to 9:30 this week so Sam can make the Westgate site walk. Same room.

subject: Out Thursday afternoon
body: Heads up, I'll be at the Westgate site walk Thursday afternoon. Reachable by phone.

subject: Printer on 2 is jammed
body: The large-format printer on the second floor is jammed again. I've called the service line.

subject: Timesheets due Friday
body: Reminder: September timesheets are due by Friday so I can run invoicing.
note: Internal mail with a date in it. Nobody outside the firm is waiting.

body: Samples have moved: tile and stone are now on shelf C, metals on shelf D.

subject: Lunch for Friday's design review
body: Ordering sandwiches for Friday's review. Reply with anything you can't eat.

subject: October holiday schedule
body: The October holiday schedule is on the shared drive.

body: The drawing index for Harbor Point is updated in the project folder. Please use the new sheet numbers from here on.

subject: Cover the Old Mill OAC meeting?
body: Can someone cover the Old Mill OAC meeting Wednesday? I have a conflict.

subject: FW: Correction Notice: Permit B-2026-1187
body:
Tom, can you take the correction response for the library? Details below.

---- Forwarded ----
Responses to correction notices are required within fourteen (14) calendar days of the date of this notice.
note: The principal passing on work for a deadline that already arrived in an earlier message. The forward is internal mail, not a second deadline; counting from the forward would also give the wrong date.

subject: Employment verification: former staff member
body: We are conducting an employment verification for a former member of your staff. Please confirm dates of employment and title at your earliest convenience.

subject: Certificate of insurance request, Old Mill
body: Our lender requires a certificate of insurance naming Old Mill Partners as additional insured on the design contract. Can you send one?

subject: Feature request: Westgate Clinic
body: We would like to feature Westgate Clinic in our spring issue. Could we set up an interview and photography?

subject: Guest critic invitation
body: Would Priya be available as a guest critic for our third-year studio reviews in October?

subject: Possible new project at 22 Mill Road
body: We own a two-story warehouse at 22 Mill Road and are considering a conversion to offices. Would you be open to a site visit?

subject: Design awards: submissions open
body: Submissions for the 2026 chapter design awards are open through November 14.

subject: Professional liability renewal documents
body: Your professional liability policy renews November 1. Please sign the attached application and return by October 15.

subject: FW: see below
body: fyi
note: Nothing here is clear enough to act on. A person reads it.

subject: Subpoena for records: Castellan Builders v. Harbor Point Development
body: Enclosed is a subpoena for project records relating to Harbor Point Residences. Please produce the requested documents within 30 days of service.
note: Fits none of the usual kinds, and the deadline is buried in legal language.
